title: MFP Source Claim
description: Normalized per-source claim model for MFPB_0_8_SOURCE_CLAIMS_CONTRACT_V0. One claim per source-local field observation. Duplicates and source-local rows are preserved; no cross-source merging is performed and no derived effective status is stored.

claim_id.description: Deterministic claim identifier derived from source identity and locator.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier from source catalog.

source_record_id.description: Source-local record identifier; may be 'unknown' if unresolved.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt accession string as provided by the source. Strict accession pattern validation is deferred.

protein_name_raw.description: Protein name text exactly as present in the source artifact.

organism_raw.description: Organism text exactly as present in the source artifact.

raw_claim_field.description: Source-native field name carrying the claim. Required even for unresolved claims.

raw_claim_value.description: Source-native value observed in the claim field. Required even for unresolved claims; use an explicit placeholder such as 'unknown' when the source value is absent.

operational_status.description: Operational status resolved per source claim policy.

primary_target_eligible.description: Primary-target benchmark eligibility. May only be true when operational_status is 'curated'.

control_eligible.description: Control benchmark eligibility. Always false in this contract; no claim is NMF/control by implication.

raw_file_path.description: Path to raw source artifact in repository.

raw_row_or_url.description: Raw row locator or source URL reference.

source_version.description: Source version marker or explicit placeholder such as 'unknown'.

retrieved_at.description: Retrieval timestamp as ISO 8601 date-time string, or explicit placeholder 'unknown'.

transformation_id.description: Identifier of transformation logic that produced the claim.
